event: On Floor 21 the schematic's corridor is twice as wide and six meters higher than noted.
Tomás records the first divergence from the Apex documentation.
Solenne's Conductor reads a deeper, pre-System ambient she has no catalog for.
Tomás notes two more divergences before the first encounter.
Hollow Wardens: stone constructs, physical-resistant, weak to arcane.
Tomás calls construct type, arcane vulnerability, formation three holds.
Dayo takes point; Miriam and Vesper run Sanctuary Weave from corridor entry.
The Wardens hit harder than documented; Tomás corrects his notes live.
Nadia runs four clean Pattern Breaks, present in the fight.
The encounter clears in eleven minutes; the Wardens sink back into stone.
Dayo asks about loot; Tomás says it went straight to inventory.
Vesper studies the point where animated stone became inert stone.
Solenne reads a fourth register in Tomás's signal: something he has not said yet.
The party pauses at a vaulted widening forty minutes short of the rest node.
Tomás opens the schematic, looks too long, and closes it.
He says he needs to tell them something.
Dayo turns from the corridor and waits.
He says he has not told them his third True Sight instance.
Solenne recalls the first two: Floor 3's dimensions and Floor 9's joint geometry.
The third was Floor 15's rest floor notice board.
An entry from before System Initialization, in modern English, described them.
By descriptor: six Harmony climbers never before seen in one party.
He recites them: Arcanist, Vanguard, Jester, Artificer, Warden, Pathfinder.
It described them as they would be, not as they were on Floor 15.
Miriam writes in the main text of her notebook.
Dayo asks how long he has known; eleven floors, since Floor 15. She nods.
Vesper's Workframe runs hot: someone built this floor.
Nadia asks what the writing looked like: handwritten or placed?
Tomás says both: modern English, deliberate handwriting, set down to be found.
Miriam asks if it was a warning or an invitation; he doesn't know.
Miriam writes something she shows no one.
The fourth register in his signal is gone, because it has been said.
Solenne realises the Conductor reads how people hold what they know, not what.
She asks if there is anything else; Tomás says not yet.
He says it wasn't meant for them, but only they would recognize it.
Walking on, Vesper studies a Hollow Warden joint section she kept.
Tomás notes the fourth divergence: the main route sealed, the side route primary.
Nadia walks at the back, receiving the floor's ambient.
Solenne recalls Tomás stopping twice at a wall to study its joint geometry.
She files it: this floor speaks to him in a language he already knows.
At a window-slit high point, Solenne sees the Transition Hall far below.
Tomás calls formation ready; Solenne rejoins it.
A second Warden cluster, four strong, more than the schematic estimated.
A darker stone section bears old markings, not Tower notation.
Tomás studies them without True Sight: documenting. Dayo holds until he nods.
They reach a small System rest node with no fire-bowl.
Vesper begins making something from the Warden joint section.
Nadia sets down the dulcimer case and opens her Level 11 skill window.
She reads it as recognition, not allocation, and closes it.
Miriam keeps writing in the main text of her notebook.
Dayo assesses the exit passage; Tomás builds his corrected map.
Solenne files the party's configuration under: this.
She picks up her pack.
